meta.concept: Ledger of Light — the ring is the full savings circle, the lit dot is the member whose turn it is. Nothing hidden, nothing owed silently.
meta.wcag_target: AA minimum for all text pairings; AAA for primary brand pairings

ink.role: Primary dark / brand foundation. Dark-mode base surface, light-mode primary text.

paper.role: Primary light / brand foundation. Light-mode base surface, dark-mode primary text.

lumen.role: Primary accent. The 'lit' color — CTAs, the symbol's dot, highlights, focus states. Use generously on dark surfaces, sparingly on light ones.

lumen-dim.role: Lumen for large text / icons on Paper only (3.2:1) — never for small body text on light backgrounds.

teal.role: Positive / growth / dividends paid / confirmed on-chain.

display.name: Fraunces
display.usage: Marketing headlines, editorial moments, section titles on landing pages only. Never in product UI.

ui.name: IBM Plex Sans
ui.usage: All product UI, body copy, buttons, navigation, forms.

mono.name: IBM Plex Mono
mono.usage: Wallet addresses, contract IDs, transaction hashes, amounts in tables, code.

logo.symbol_concept: A ring (the full contribution cycle / the group) with one lit dot on its edge (the member currently receiving the payout). Transparent by construction — everyone can see whose turn it is.
logo.clearspace_rule: Clearspace around any lockup = the height of the symbol's ring, on all sides.
do_not: Do not recolor the ring and dot to the same color outside approved monochrome variants
Do not stretch or skew the wordmark
Do not place the color lockup on a busy photographic background — use a monochrome variant instead
Do not recreate the wordmark by typing 'Lumio' in a generic font — use the outlined files
